cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were diluted with 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and digested overnight at 37 °C with trypsin (1:200 enzyme-to-protein ratio).

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS was performed in Top20 mode with HCD fragmentation (NCE 28%), using 15,000 resolution for MS2 scans.

enrichment_method.evidence: For acetylated peptide enrichment, desalted peptides were resuspended in IAP buffer and incubated with anti-acetyl-lysine antibody beads (Cell Signaling Technology) at 4 °C for 4 hours.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were analyzed using an Ultimate 3000 nano UHPLC system coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer with an ESI nanospray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
